description: This file contains unit tests for the internal unordered_map modifiers in the Abseil C++ library, using Google Test framework. It tests various map modification operations such as insert, erase, clear, swap, and special cases with unique_ptr values.

classes.name: ModifiersTest
classes.description: A parameterized test suite for testing various modifier operations on unordered maps.

classes.name: UniquePtrModifiersTest
classes.description: A specialized test suite for maps with std::unique_ptr as mapped_type, ensuring no move from rvalue arguments occurs on failed insertions.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Tests the clear() method resets the map to empty.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Tests inserting a single element into the map.

methods.name: InsertHint
methods.description: Tests inserting with a hint iterator.

methods.name: InsertRange
methods.description: Tests inserting a range of elements.

methods.name: InsertWithinCapacity
methods.description: Tests inserting elements without increasing bucket count.

methods.name: InsertRangeWithinCapacity
methods.description: Tests inserting a range of elements within capacity constraints.

methods.name: InsertOrAssignHint
methods.description: Tests insert_or_assign with a hint iterator (C++17).

methods.name: EmplaceHint
methods.description: Tests emplacing with a hint iterator.

methods.name: TryEmplaceHint
methods.description: Tests try_emplace with a hint iterator (C++17).

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Tests erasing an element via iterator.

methods.name: EraseRange
methods.description: Tests erasing a range of elements.

methods.name: EraseKey
methods.description: Tests erasing an element by key.
